email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca XR patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 58-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their third dose of DemoGluca XR (dose: 25mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-06-05.
Approximately 5 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
M. Okafor (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
